name: Stonecraft Interiors
description: A mid-sized interior design firm specialising in residential renovations and custom furniture fitting. They have been operating for 6 years and rely mostly on word of mouth.
compliment: Their branding and colors are really unique i can see they have put in a lot of effort
issues: No website at all. Only a Facebook page that was last updated 8 months ago. No way for potential clients to see their portfolio or contact them online.

name: Nova Renovation Co
description: A home renovation contractor offering kitchen remodels bathroom upgrades and general structural work for residential properties.
compliment: They have a lot of 5 star reviews show the quality of work they provide
issues: They have a website but it was built in 2017. It is not mobile friendly loads very slowly has no portfolio section and the contact form is broken.

name: Amber Home Design
description: A boutique interior design studio targeting high end clients. They offer full room design services including sourcing furniture decor and lighting
compliment: Really nice portfolio their work really stands out
issues: Their website exists but has no clear call to action no pricing information and the portfolio images are low quality and unprofessional. The site looks abandoned.
